note: Everything that moves on Hoi An's river and in its sky, driven on the GPU by assets/shaders/LanternDrift.gdshader (src/environment/LanternDrift.gd; no CPU per frame). boats: lantern-lit sampans in lanes along the river, each lane one direction (dir +1 downstream to the east) and one speed so boats never pass through each other; the lanes run between An Hoi bridge's piers (landmarks.json an_hoi_bridge, piers at a quarter, half and three quarters of its length) and under its arch. river_lanterns: candle lanterns drifting downstream; `release` of them are let go just below An Hoi bridge and drift release_span metres, the rest drift the whole river; shapes: weight per shape id (10 classic paper lotus, 11 open water lily, 12 closed bud, 13 lotus on a lily pad); colours: palette indices. sky_lanterns: paper lanterns released from the release_areas ({rect [x0, z0, x1, z1], y, weight}: the river, the promenades, the rooftops all over town; none over the square, which the gameplay camera looks at, nor the riverfront and river in front of it, where a rising lantern would cross the camera's view of the lawn) that climb `rise` metres in `period` seconds while the wind carries them east and south, then fade and are released again; shapes 20 hood, 21 globe, 22 cylinder, 23 teardrop; size [min, max]. river_span: [x0, x1] of the river the boats and lanterns travel (past both island edges); fade metres at each end they shrink in and out of. palette: the lantern colours (sRGB hex): 0-7 the silk colours of architecture/lantern_kit.mjs LANTERN_COLORS, 8-11 warm paper whites and ambers for sky lanterns.
